messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breach on chat.completions (route: /v1/chat/completions) — 3m sustained above 1.6s. Pager triggered to @maria. Link: https://observability.redwood/p/alerts/1234

maria: seeing the page. I'm pulling traces now. possible region spike in us-west-2?

aj: I can join, on call handoff note: I'm the secondary for tonight. If it's noisy, consider squelching per-model rather than global.

maria: agreed. initial look: p95 stable, p99 bubbled for routes hitting mistral-7b and default-chat. p99 for small models unaffected.

leo: digging into serving nodes — a few pods in pool-3 had high load (90%+), CPU throttling visible on one host. might be gc/backpressure from a particular model variant.

maria: customer impact check — I queried request counts and errors. Errors unchanged, successful but slow. top customers by volume: alpha-saas, notebook-inc — hourly latency increase ~180ms for alpha-saas but p99 spikes to 2s for notebook-inc.

sara: FYI there's an enterprise customer (notebook-inc) on Dedicated; ops/Sales will want the initial blameless note. please tag me when we have the mitigation.

devin: for quick mitigation we can: 1) temporarily route traffic away from pool-3 to pool-1 (same region), 2) raise p99 alert threshold for mistral-7b to 2.2s while we investigate, or 3) enable a per-model squelch for 15m. prefer #1 + #3.

maria: plan: start with routing (devin), and per-model squelch (aj) so we stop paging for noisy model while we debug. then re-evaluate thresholds. any objections? :thinking_face:

aj: +1. I'll create a short-lived squelch rule in alerts (15m) with reason "oncall mitigation - route spike". command: 
```
# datadog: mute alert 1234 for tag:model:mistral-7b duration:15m reason:"oncall mitigation"
```
I'll post the exact command once I run it.

devin: starting routing change now — moving 20% of mistral-7b traffic off pool-3 to pool-1 using canary routing. command: 
```
redwood route set --route chat.completions --model mistral-7b --split 80:20 --from pool-3:pool-1
```
Should be instantaneous, will watch telemetry.

incident-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE: split update accepted (80:20). ID: rc_8892.

maria: monitoring p99 panels. initial 2m: slight drop in p99 for mistral-7b from 2.0s -> 1.6s. good sign.

leo: confirmed; nodes in pool-3 show reduced queue depth. looks like some hosts were overheating and causing serial stalls. still investigating root cause on that host.

aj: squelch created: alert 1234 muted for tag:model:mistral-7b until +15m. note: this is temporary — we agreed to not permanently change alerting without post-incident analysis.

sara: thanks. please flag if Dedicated customer impact beyond 30m. I'll prepare a customer-facing blameless update template.

maria: quick checklist for post-incident: 1) run a per-route p95/p99 sensitivity analysis, 2) create a dashboard panel that splits p95/p99 by model and route for last 90d, 3) consider adding a noise gate for p99 alerts (min-sustained-count).

devin: for the dashboard panel, suggest this Datadog query (adapted):
```
avg:last_5m:1000 * (percentile(avg:service.latency{env:prod,route:chat.completions} by {model}, 99))
```
We'll want separate widgets for p95/p99 and a table view for top 20 model-route combos.

maria: logging todos inline: 
- (maria) write timeline and initial mitigation notes in incident doc
- (aj) file follow-up to investigate pool-3 host failures and GC tuning (owner: aj)
- (devin) create dashboard panel splitting p95/p99 by model + route (owner: devin)
- (leo) collect heap/gc logs from pool-3 hosts & check kernel dmesg for OOM/thermal events
- (sara) draft customer blameless note and coordinate with account team

aj: one more immediate action: we should add a min-count condition to the p99 alert so a single enterprise customer with heavy tail doesn't keep paging everyone. propose: alert only if sustained 5% of traffic or >500 requests in 5m AND p99 > threshold. I'll sketch the rule today.

maria: yes. that's exactly the kind of noise reduction we need. For thresholds, I propose per-model thresholds in alert config rather than global:
- mistral-7b: p99 = 2.0s (alert), p95 = 0.5s
- default-chat: p99 = 1.6s, p95 = 0.35s
- redwood-alpha: p99 = 1.0s, p95 = 0.25s
These are initial proposals, we'll validate with the 90d distribution.

devin: capture that in an RFC and also instrument the alerting service to accept per-model overrides. currently it's per-route only. adding per-model will reduce noisy cross-model pages.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation in place (routing + squelch). escalation status: resolved for paging. Follow-up required for root cause and alert tuning.

maria: marking this thread for handoff. aj, you'll own the RCA + alert tuning RFC; devin will own dashboard; leo will own host forensic; sara will own customer comms. I'll update the incident doc with timeline and close the pager.

aj: on it. I'll open a follow-up ticket and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to review proposed threshold numbers.

maria: thanks everyone. pulling off pager now. :white_check_mark:

leo: thanks — will drop logs into the ticket.

sara: sending note to account team with mitigation summary now.

maria: end of thread.
